title: TagNest Export
description: JSON Schema for a TagNest full-library export (the body of GET /api/export?format=json). The envelope is stable and round-trips through the import flow. This file also documents the data boundary the AI features may see.

application.description: Producer marker. Imports reject files whose application is not 'TagNest'.

version.description: Export format version. Bumped only on a breaking envelope change.

exportedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the export was generated.

bookmarks.description: The user's bookmarks. Soft-deleted (trash) entries are included only when includeTrash=1.

url.description: Canonical bookmark URL. This is the stable identity used to de-duplicate on re-import.

tags.description: Tag names attached to the bookmark. Imported as new tags when absent.

aiSummary.description: AI-generated summary. Present only when the AI feature produced one.

visitCount.description: Number of times the bookmark was opened. Present only when includeVisits=1.

lastVisitedAt.description: Last open timestamp. Present only when includeVisits=1.

snapshotKey.description: Latest R2 snapshot object key (card preview). Carried so a TagNest→TagNest migration preserves the reference. The R2 binary blob is NOT part of this envelope.

snapshotKeys.description: R2 object keys of all retained snapshots (oldest→newest). Carried so a TagNest→TagNest migration (Y4) preserves snapshot references. The R2 binary blobs themselves are NOT part of this JSON envelope; the target instance re-fetches or shows a placeholder when a key has no local blob.

collections.description: Reading lists (curated collections) with their member URLs in order.

urls.description: Member bookmarks referenced by URL so the list survives internal id churn.
